**New PC:** download `FLEX.exe`, put it in a folder of its own and run it; it fetches FFmpeg on the first start. **PS5:** copy the `FLEX` folder from `FLEX-ps5.zip` to `/data/homebrew/`. **Android TV box, phone or tablet:** install `FLEX-android.apk`. Full steps: [docs/setup.md](https://github.com/MrRobotto512/FLEX/blob/main/docs/setup.md).

**Already installed:** FLEX updates itself (tray menu → Update), consoles update from their server (Options on the grid), and the Android app offers the new version once its server has it.

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `FLEX.exe` | Windows app: server, settings window, tray, and the full-screen player for a PC under the TV |
| `flexd.exe` | the same server without a window |
| `FLEX-ps5.zip` | PS5 client for a first install |
| `FLEX-ps5.elf` | PS5 client, what servers hand to consoles |
| `FLEX-android.apk` | Android / Android TV app (the web client full screen) |
| `SHA256SUMS` | checksums every update is verified against |
